detaileddescription.para: set_ref_date_of_ae provides a means of specifying the reference date of the NH autumnal equinox for a particular year. It is only used if calls are made to the calandar versions of the routines diurnal_solar and daily_mean_solar. If the NOLEAP calendar is used, then the date of autumnal equinox will be the same every year. If JULIAN is used, then the date of autumnal equinox will return to the same value every 4th year.
